basis: Each individual lift is reported by Influint against nearby publication-date uploads. Family medians below are computed from those published lifts, with memberships supplied by Influint.
method: No cherry-picked regex grouping: use each actual details.fmt membership; compare family median, sample size, date range, recent subset, best and weakest entries.
limitations: Observational package/content performance, not title-only causation.
No new-channel first-28-day forecast or CTR conclusion.
Catalogue coverage notes disagree with some rendered counts; these are displayed cohorts, not guaranteed complete histories.
Some tiles explicitly annotate 28d views while the global scoring note says lifetime. Those flags are retained; raw view-window fields remain unresolved and do not drive this comparison.
Recent subsets are descriptive, often small, and not matched tests of freshness.
Primary YouTube search snapshots may show different view counts/dates from the retained Influint snapshot; do not blend them.
A 2x qualifying outlier is a threshold, not proof of transfer; compare distinct creators and execution as well.

editorial_decisions.decision: Lead with concrete cheap-versus-expensive contrast, then name the object. Use the exact secret-room reference; its 1.97x is below the 2x outlier threshold.

Retain secret rooms for brand fit and visible ingenuity. The Stokes family median is 1.005x across 10 entries; selected wins do not prove every secret-room title works. Bigger room counts are not a proven improvement.

Make the promised physical problem larger and show the test. A superlative or larger number alone is not the engine: MrBeast Gaming world-superlative family median is 0.83x across 9 entries despite individual wins.
Use the user-specified wording and whole-crew performance. Evidence supports prank/job families, not the causal superiority of I/We wording. Secretly making GTA harder is an untested adaptation.

Keep the clear decision or build-and-buy promise. Do not treat a cash number as sufficient: reward families have uneven outcomes, and a real million-dollar payout is not within confirmed pilot funding.

Replace map lore, mechanics exposition and twin-only stakes with visible disaster, loss of control, wish fulfillment and a crew mystery. This is the user’s creative direction; the dataset does not prove that GTA or gaming words are inherently weak.

Develop the cities journey and Earth race as explicit experiments. Real references support related spectacle; this research did not establish a qualifying exact performance precedent for either mixed-world engine.
